def: Put, a son of Ham, also the name of his descendants or their region, and of a Persian tribe

occurrences.text: And the sons of Ham; Cush, and Mizraim, and Phut, and Canaan.
The sons of Ham; Cush, and Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.
Come up, ye horses; and rage, ye chariots; and let the mighty men come forth; the Ethiopians and the Libyans, that handle the shield; and the Lydians, that handle and bend the bow.
They of Persia and of Lud and of Phut were in thine army, thy men of war: they hanged the shield and helmet in thee; they set forth thy comeliness.
Ethiopia, and Libya, and Lydia, and all the mingled people, and Chub, and the men of the land that is in league, shall fall with them by the sword.
Persia, Ethiopia, and Libya with them; all of them with shield and helmet:
Ethiopia and Egypt were her strength, and it was infinite; Put and Lubim were thy helpers.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
